Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a two-vehicle collision on a Houston, Texas roadway where Driver 1 was changing lanes and
made contact with the side of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle and was identified as the named
insured on the policy. A Passenger was also present in the vehicle and was confirmed at the scene by officers and
independent witnesses. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash. Based on the direction of
impact and the vehicles' speeds, the reported injury appears consistent with the kind and force of this collision.
Witnesses, scene photographs, and Driver 2 each gave accounts that matched the sequence of events described by
Driver 1. Officers observed no indication that the vehilce had sustained prior damage, and none is known from
records reviewed. Damage observed on the vehicles was visible along the side panels, but it remains unclear
whether all of the damage recorded resulted from this single impact and further inspection will be needed to
determine that question.
